[quote=united_hydronia;60011227][spoiler=[b]defending[/b]]
After failure to intercept the majority of the missiles, the ornate squadron would be rerouted to the east to aid in defending the skies during the ongoing landing. Small air defence systems situated at Military targets would fire surface-to-air interceptors at the Donnerkeil missiles as they approached, hoping to minimise damage, but oil refineries and other infrastructure would take heavy hits.

Jamming and chaff spraying would be employed to help protect the Hydronians against the incoming missiles. As the jets took evasive action, jamming would attempt to disable the missiles and chaff would attempt to confuse their radar. As the submarines in the water continued to take down the Kaiserreichs fleet, the missiles would become less and less accurate due to less information inputs. These tactics would be employed to deal with both rounds of missiles simultaneously, but at least 2 jets would be downed.

Despite appearing like a ridiculous idea, these acoustic-guided missiles are more useful than they seem. Due to their already close proximity to the drones when being released, it is far easier for them to lock onto them. This is greatly aided by the incredibly sensitive fine tuning of the sensors. Whilst this is still an experimental technology, it does have its uses.

The Mach 6 missiles high manoeuvrability due to light weight and thrust nozzles would allow them to avoid the interceptors relatively easily. Their ability to reaccelerate would then come into play. Once it had avoided the interceptors it would lock back onto the jets with their laser homing and speed back up to Mach 6 to quickly take down the jets.

The Kaiserreich used ATTs to attempt to cover their fleet from the submarine attacks, but they would not be so successful. Due to the torpedoes being launched almost directly underneath the  kaiserreichs ships, the torpedoes would be very hard to intercept. They essentially used the technocratic fleet as cover from their own weapons and sonars. The window to detect and launch interceptors is very small from such proximity and so it would be difficult for the Kaiserreich to launch ATTs quick enough and accurately enough. Most of the torpedoes would continue towards their targets as the submarines continued their tactics of staying deep in the water to avoid detection, then rising up directly underneath ships to release their payload, before diving back down into the depths of the North Sea.

The enemy torpedoes would be dealt with by Hydronias ATTs. The enemy subs would be dealt with by the same torpedoes used to destroy the fleet. The submarines would fire small, agile torpedoes towards the swarming UUVs, whilst taking evasive action. These torpedoes would work to intercept the swarm, whilst using jamming tactics to misguide the UUVs.

The highly sensitive mines would be set off by even the slightest pressure change. Some of the mines would be set off as the UUVs approached them, but others would end up being safely dismantled, allowing the ship through. The Radar would take heavy hits, with nearly all of it being disabled. This wouldnt concern the Hydronians too much however as they had already served their purpose.

Despite small fire doing nothing to the AAVs, Hydronias firework-3400 man-portable missile launchers would be employed to destroy the approaching AAVs and other armoured vehicles. Huge numbers of these missiles would be fired towards the landing party, it would be impossible to intercept them all. The firework-3400s would also be loaded with small interceptor missiles. Multitudes of these would be fired towards the Donnerkeils to help protect the troops as well as into the sky against the jets. The JDAMs and cluster bombs would do heavy damage to the Hydronian infantry. The machine gunners and snipers would be able to take cover behind hills to avoid the incoming fire.

Since the missiles failed to deal significant damage to the LCACs, the machine gunners up in the hills would be given orders to also target the LCACs.

The missiles would continue to fire at the AAVs. Huge numbers of the missiles would be used to overwhelm the enemy. They couldnt all be intercepted. Due to the portable nature of the missile launchers, they would be moved behind the protective hills before anything could hit them. They would continue to fire from behind the hills.

The Kaiserreich jets had reacted too late. Air-to-air missiles were already well on their way towards the jets. Interceptors open up on the Hydronian missiles, but due to their relative cheapness compared to hypersonic missiles, huge barrages of then would be fired to exhaust the enemy of their interception capabilities. The jets would take evasive action whilst using jamming devices to avoid the enemys attempts to take them down.

The Kaiserreichs supply lines had so far seemed unstoppable, but Hydronias earlier mentioned submarine tactics would deal with that. As new ships approached the speedy submarines would begin targeting them too, launching barrages of torpedoes from underneath.

The countermeasures against the missiles would do a good job for the most part, except for one major flaw. The size of the aircraft compared to the missiles would allow them to continue in the same direction and hit the aircraft, despite the lack of targeting capabilities. Damage would be lower than the Hydronians wished, but it would still hinder the Kaiserreich.

[i]- BEFORE THE LANDING -[/i]

Spotting the paratroopers as they jumped would prove difficult due to the time of day, but the machine gunners had adopted a tactic of simply spraying bullets throughout the air to maximise the amount of troops they could stop before they hit the ground. The high number of machine gunners present would allow this tactic to work well, with bullets filling the night sky. Any soldiers who landed in unintended areas would be shot on sight to swiftly eliminate any threat they posed. As the enemy troops used their vehicles to quickly attempt to sabotage Hydronian targets, they would be stopped. As they approached airfields and other locations, huge numbers of Hydronian troops would be waiting. Earlier, Hydronian scouts had spotted the helicopters and both notified the machine gunners and nearby bases similar. The Hydronian numbers would be able to quickly surround and overwhelm the small in comparison Kaiserreich teams.
[/spoiler]

[nation]Sikirsk[nation] send some ships over here man 🙏[/quote]
[spoiler=[b]OOC Stuff[/b]]

-Acoustic missiles arent used for a variety of reasons in the air. Sound quickly dissipates and is affected by a wide range of factors including humidity, wind etc. The noise of the engine also makes them highly inaccurate. 

-Making the mach 6 missiles extremely maneuverable due to light airframes is probably unrealistic. Speeding up to mach 6, slowing down rapidly and then being able to speed up to mach 6 again would require heavy and extremely expensive systems like rocket boosters with scram jets that are capable of switching modes and variable thrust. The missile would also need a ton of thermal protection to handle massive changes in heat and airflow weighing it down further. 

-Machine gunners and snipers hiding behind hills from a 5,000 lb JDAM probably wouldnt protect them. The US used JDAMs to hit deeply entrenched cave complexes in Afghanistan so a couple hills probably wouldnt be very effective in protecting them.[/spoiler]  

[spoiler=[b]Reichswehr Offensive[/b]]

After heavy damage was done to the Hydronian oil industry, the Reichswehr would utilize another card up its sleeve to deal with the remaining oil infrastructure. The B25-EL strategic stealth bomber developed in coordination with Jomsland and the Oceanice Republic would take to the skies from Reichswehr controlled air bases in Hydronian territory. With a loadout of 40,000 lbs in ordinance the B25-ELs would move south with the purpose of crippling the Hydronian oil industry permanently. Its stealth capabilities would make it nearly impossible to intercept. The design of the aircraft including its flying wing shape as well as purposeful configuration would make it appear as small as an insect on radar. Radar absorbing materials would absorb radar waves instead of reflecting them. The engines of the aircraft are burned inside its fuselage, this on top of cooling would give it almost no infrared signature. Flying into Hydronian territory at night and at extremely high altitudes would further reduce the chances of interception. Upon reaching the south of Hydronia, each of the aircraft would unload 40,000 lbs of ordinance onto the oil infrastructure. JDAMs would be dropped onto oil refineries, pipelines, loading docks, petrochemical factories and strategic stockpiles of petrol. The purpose of this would be to not only deal a massive economic blow to the Hydronians but to also to destroy the oil used in the war effort. Ships, armored vehicles, aircraft, and other vehicles would all be indirectly impacted by the raid. 

Jamming and chaff would have little effect on the Gunslinger missiles as they made their way towards the Hydronian aircraft. The collaborative interfaces used to guide the missiles wouldnt be disturbed. On top of the aircraft, ships and other radars now ground based radar would also provide insight into the location of Hydronian aircraft. Infrared systems onboard would also help the missiles track the heat signature coming off the engines of the Hydronian aircraft. Dozens of eyes from the air, ground and sea would ensure the deadly accuracy of the Gunslinger and Rakete missiles as they fly towards the Hydronian jets. The accuracy of acoustic missiles would be highly dubious. Sound dissipates quickly in air and is easily affected by wind and humidity on top of the sound of the missiles. Fine tuning for the sounds of very silent rotors would be like searching for a needle in a stack of hay. Ultimately, the interceptors would probably be ineffective and more importantly a waste of resources. A most likely multi-million dollar interceptor, even if by some miracle using acoustic sensors hit a drone it would have little effect on the war effort. These mass producible drones, costing only 50k each, would flood into Hydronian airspace. The missiles are definitely experimental, the Reichswehr would observe, and should have stayed in theory rather than on the realities of the battlefield. 

Under-keel sonar would allow the fleet to look directly below them at the submarines. The Hydronians falsely believed that staying underneath them would provide them cover but sticking so close made them quick targets. Under-keel sonar paired with detection utilized by UUVs and EDU submarines would allow the ATTs to accurately intercept the torpedoes. While most torpedoes are intercepted some manage to break through and sink the TKS Eisenwald guided missile cruiser. The rest of the fleet, however, sustains minor damage. Now, however, the Reichswehr would counterattack. The Hydronian subs, coming close to the surface to launch their torpedoes and extremely close to the under keel sonar would be clearly identifiable. The TKS Hohenkrone submarine would fire dozens of torpedoes towards the enemy submarines. The fire from the submarine would be joined by helicopters, surface ships, and maritime patrol aircraft giving the Kaiserreich overwhelming firepower. The Sturmfisch torpedoes would have a variety of countermeasures that work to maximize their chances of destroying the enemy submarines. Due to the close range of the submarines, the Sturmfisch sprints to 70 knots allowing it to quickly close the gap and avoid slower ATTs. Using unpredictable maneuvers it also aims to throw off interceptors and it also utilizes acoustic counter-countermeasures to quickly identify between decoys, targets and defensive torpedoes. While moving towards the enemy submarines the torpedoes have yet another defensive mechanism up its sleeve. Acoustic decoys that mimic the signature of the torpedoes are deployed to waste ATTs while acoustic jammers work to blind the submarine's sonar. The wide range of firing platforms: submarines, UUVs, aircraft, and surface craft allow massed saturation attacks to even further maximize the chance of completely destroying the Hydronian submarine fleet. On top of torpedoes fired from aircraft, helicopters, submarines and surface craft the Kaiserreichs UUVs would continue their assaults. Jamming would have little to no effect on the fully autonomous systems which dont rely on constant links with their surface controllers. The massive swarm would easily shoulder the hits of torpedoes, the individual UUVs being easily expendable due to their low cost. Submarines trying to enact evasive maneuvers would find it near impossible to shake off the swarm. A hive mind of collective intelligence used to control the swarm, trained off trillions of data points would constantly identify and keep up the chase. Constantly firing torpedoes, the UUVs not only work to destroy the submarines but also waste their vital supplies of dwindling ATTs as the main strike arrives. 

AAV soft kill systems would be activated to deal with the incoming barrage of missiles. Widespread spoofing would be used to mislead the missiles and confuse their targeting systems to reduce the risk of interception. On top of this other soft kill systems would be deployed. Smoke screens would be launched to cover the moving armored vehicles to break the lock. Finally any remaining missiles would be dealt with by the active protection systems. From the skies,  the EK-18 electronic warfare aircraft begin DFRM to intercept radar signals and send false signals to mislead the man portable systems. Small interceptor munitions would be used to hit the missiles before they arrive. Three layers of defense would prove effective, however, two AAVs would be destroyed nonetheless. By this time, however, the beachhead had been fully secured with the constant movements of armored vehicles into the area quickly filling the losses. 

The Hydronians had attempted to use their portable missile systems as a cure all for their lack of combined arms fire. However, they wouldnt prove anywhere near effective with the cruise missiles. The extremely high speeds of the Donnerkeil cruise missiles would make interception using man portable missiles extremely improbable. Cruise missiles also significantly outrange the man-portable missiles(US javelin: 2.5 km, stinger: 4 km) allowing them to outrun and then outrange them. The same situation would happen with the jets. Firing towards the jets would prove rather ineffective as well. Dropping JDAMs from high altitudes including from 35,000 feet would keep the jets far from the man-portable missiles as they drop JDAMs onto those missile launchers. 

The J-16s would quickly strike back against the missile launchers, machine gunners and snipers. Their tactic of hiding behind hills would be quickly unraveled as the 5,000 lb JDAMs fell. The massive ordinance combined with UAV surveillance would be easily able to slam into the men even if they were hiding in the hills. The 5,000 lb JDAMs had been used to crush Sikirskian troops in the mountains of Nestorstaat, the hills of Hydronia wouldnt be any more challenging. Machine gun fire onto the LCACs would prove ineffective. Fast speeds, significant distances and active protections systems would ward off the majority of machine gun attacks. 

The J-15Es use their vast array of electronic warfare capabilities to hinder the air to air missiles. Barrage jamming would be utilized by flooding a wide array of frequencies with static to block guidance systems. At the same time spoofing is utilized by making fake targets appear on the targeting systems of the missiles to mislead them. For infrared tracking missiles flares that burn hotter than the engines of the jets would be deployed to lead them away. Cheaper direct energy weapons are used on the J-16s to intercept the incoming missiles as a kinetic strike. 

Radar absorbing materials on the jets allow them to absorb radar pings to appear much smaller than they are. However, the lack of targeting abilities on the Hydronian missiles would let the J-16s to simply move out of the way to avoid being hit. 

Using the above mentioned anti-submarine tactics the escort ships would work to intercept the submarines far before they are able to hit the supply ships. 

The descending paratroopers, spread out over an area cover a very small volume of space while dispersed. The chances of random spraying of machine gun fire in hitting a paratrooper would be highly unlikely. Reichswehr paratroopers would use their advanced equipment as a force multiplier against the larger Hydronian forces. Using their thermal sights, combined their laser range finders and ACOG 4x magnification scopes they would be able to accurately shoot the wildly firing Hydronian forces. Use of FPV drones would be widespread as the paratroopers utilize suicide drones to bomb groups of Hydronian troops and armored vehicles at relatively low costs. Engaging Hydronian troops would be part of the plan. Once encountering enemy fire the paratroopers would call in rapid air support. Within minutes JDAMs and cluster munitions would be dropped onto the enemy by J-16s.[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]Pushing Into the East[/b]]

By the third day of landings a combined force of 75,000 Reichswehr troops had been brought in via LCAC and helicopter landings. Along with heavy tanks, AAVs and IFVs the heavily armored Reichswehr troops would begin to rapidly push into eastern Hydronia. Followed by close air support provided by the JDAMs of the J-16s, the Reichswehr would utilize overwhelming firepower to push further and further into the country. As they push further into the country, the Engineer Korps establish landing zones and runways to airlift in supplies and troops. K-130s defended by J-15Es and ground based air defense systems help swell the numbers of troops and armored vehicles in the area. 

As they go the Engineer Korps helps repair roads, build makeshift bridges and remove mines along with autonomous systems. Forward repair units, supply trucks, medevac and petrol follow close behind to sustain the heavy arms advance into Hydronia. Unlike the Hydronians, whose oil infrastructure was hit by hundreds of Donnerkeil cruise missiles along with a B-25EL strike, the armored vehicles of the Kaiserreich are well supplied. Fuel bladders along with oil tankers help provide constant fuel to the armored divisions to outmatch their Hydronian counterparts.[/spoiler]

[spoiler=Appetizer (1781W)]

The swarm begins its venture to satiate its great hunger, multiple hive ships begin channeling. A great rift tears through space and time as their psionic power is unleashed. A rift, nearly the size of a continent, is formed. The hive ships move into the rift disappearing into nothingness on their hunt. The rift closes as the last of the seven hive ships enters. In the cosmic rift bright beams of energy illuminate the hive ships' paths, a light shining as bright as the sun draws them in like moths to a flame, this light is the lifeforce of the people living on the planet Scoria a system unfortunately close to vorax space, this is the light of their souls, their emotions. The hive ships begin wading through the cosmic rift moving at speeds faster than light as they near the unknowing populace of Scoria. Scoria is home to a small colony of inhabitants from a shattered star empire, they are on their own out here. The cosmic rift is rough and takes a great toll on the hive ships, lashing out with energy made from emotions, storms of lost souls and anger swirl throughout the cosmic rift, but the hive ships have grown accustomed to this way of travel their thick hides equal to that of the strongest durasteel plating on star cruisers, they travel with little care for the tempests that rage around them. Time and space move much differently here in the cosmic rift, what would be light years at light speed takes the vorax only two days. They have reached the Delthus solar system, and are in range of Scoria. The rift begins to rip open once more, energy of the rift pours out into deep space as the vorax hive ships emerge through the hole in reality itself. The hive ships have seemingly appeared out of thin air. To the people on Scoria there were no signs of FTL warp drives, only a large solar storm which lasted for nearly thirty minutes before the hive ships emerged. Multiple unclassified bioforms were being picked up on screen, sizes ranging from seven to ten kilometers in length. These lumbering giants moved upon the planet big and slow as they approached. The planet's militum began to ready itself, they saw what was coming. Orbital gauss turrets, and flak cannons trained on their targets, missile pods began launching their salvos. Any and all starfighters were scrambled immediately, bombers, fighters, interceptors, anything with space fairing capabilities was deployed. Multiple cruisers began moving to intercept, but they were far out on the other side of the planet. The hive ships pressed on, missiles making their mark slamming into the thick carapace of the hive ships. The gauss turrets and flak cannons open fire, but the gauss rounds do little with the hive ships not even feeling the flak. The vorax hive ships are in range, and the vanguard start to release their many, many flyers. The flak tears apart the flyers but for every flyer killed ten more take its place. It's like a cloud of flesh moving uncaring for the defenders' desperate attempts. The star fighters are almost instantly overwhelmed by the voraxs' numbers, as they fall so do the planetary defense platforms, one hive ship rams straight through one of the platforms splitting it in two. Way above the sky a huge shadow is cast down upon the inhabitants of the world, clouds of skin and bones dot the sky, as massive bodies blot out the sun. In orbit the hive ships sit, over the planet's horizon approaches two cruisers Helios, and her sister ship Phanes. They get into range and begin to fire at the hive ships, but they are woefully outnumbered. Rounds connect and form cracks in the closest hive ship's armor, but the swarm of flyers begin to creep up upon the cruisers. The vorax hive ships in range begin launching spore clusters at the cruisers. These are large clumps of vorax creatures filled with vesper, a volatile liquid capable of causing devastating explosions when it reacts to certain chemicals found inside vorax spores. The cruisers open fire on the incoming flyers shredding through hundreds before they ever get close to the ships, but their numbers seem endless. Before the flyers reach the Helios, a spore cluster slams into the bow of the ship, ripping apart multiple decks, and sublevels within the ship. The front of the ship splintered many of the deck guns either blown up completely or torn from the hull by the blast. The ship continues to fire despite its shields totally failing and hull integrity at sixty eight percent. The flyers then make impact, now with multiple layers of the ship peeled back they begin to seep into the wounds of the ship. A second spore cluster approaches but detonates prematurely off the starboard side rocking the vessel but not causing any damage, it doesn't need to. The flyers have already entered the ship and have begun consuming it from the inside out. A third spore cluster hits the ship impacting the bridge. Her sister ship Phanes loses contact with the Helios. The ship begins to drift aimlessly and starts to fall out of orbit down to the planet's surface. The flyers and hive ships now turn their attention to the Phanes. The Phanes now alone and hopelessly outmatched begins its final stand. Deck guns ring out, vibrating through the cruisers hull. Rounds bore through the swarms of flyers and slam into the closest hive ship, the projectiles burrow into the hive ships flesh before exploding, sending chunks of armor and flesh careening throughout space. Blood spurts from the holes made in the hive ships skin. The hive ship fires off multiple spore clusters, knowing the devastation they cause the cruiser focuses fire upon the clusters. They explode killing many flyers in proximity, one gets close to the portside before exploding violently, rocking the cruiser causing many aboard to lose their balance. The flyers outside the ship are like bugs on a windshield, it's impossible to have a visual on the hive ships, but their massive bio signatures cannot be hidden. The flyers coat the ship in a layer of flesh biting and clawing at the ship's exterior. The shields hold strong despite their relentless assault, and the cruiser keeps firing, cleaving through the swarms of flyers as rounds make impact with one the hive ships. The hive ship feels this great pain, a throbbing headache for the gigantic creature, it begins to charge angered by the resilience of this prey. Rounds from the cruiser slam into the front of the hive ship. Some bounce while others lodge into the flesh and detonate, the Phanes then has a sudden loss of power. It was only momentary, lights flickered on and off for just a brief second, but to what caused it the crew didn't know, and then multiple warning messages were being displayed. Ion engines began to heat up, something was starting to block or clog their propulsion. At the aft of the ship vorax flyers began throwing themselves into the engines, causing damage to their components but also started to clog the engines with their bodies. Flesh burned and the bones started to char but with so much biomass being thrown into the engines they simply started to overheat. Eventually all power to the engines was lost, as the engines themselves overheated and internal components began to melt and fuse together. The Phanes is now drifting, the hive ship grows ever closer, with the Phanes still firing, the hive ship opens its maw and bites down on the ship. Multiple decks are sheared instantly, power from the ship drains, lights flicker before being snuffed out, and the vorax hive ship consumes the rest of the Phanes. On the surface the helios is seen, its reentry into the atmosphere makes it glow bright orange, chunks of the ship tear off from the main body as it descends, what left of the ship crashes hard into the soil of Scoria, a massive explosion erupts from the wreckage, a blinding light as the reactor goes critical from the crash. Overhead sits the Hive ships, command finally loses contact with the Phanes. Planetary cannons are now ordered to open fire up at the aggressors, huge plasma cannons begin to charge, they glow a spectacular blue before opening fire. Beams of plasma lurch up burning the underbellys of one of the closest hive ships. The rounds burn and sear the flesh, liquifying armor and rupturing internals. The hit was seen from the ground, a bright blue glow impacted the hive ship, but even this wasn't able to bring it down, though it looks significantly weakened. The other six begin to unload their pods, these flesh capsules have thick bone beaks containing a complement of around 20 swarmlings shot out from the underbelly of the ships, they rain down like hail. The flyers follow suit and begin tormenting the guns, flak opens up firing at flyers and pods. The pods, though hit heavily by flak, make landfall, their contents spilling out laying waste to any poor soul in proximity. Any form of ground defense is quickly overwhelmed as chaos showers over the planet. Atmospheric fighters face the worst of all threats, above them drop pods become a flight hazard as shriekers and harbingers pick apart any defender still left flying. The skys have fallen to the vorax, and the ground is soon to follow. Fewer and fewer planetary guns fire off into the setting sky, before long, the last remaining guns are silenced, hope has been extinguished, there is no more chance of survival for the people of Scoria. Cities are overwhelmed from the air, and from the land, the vorax are too vicious, and are in numbers no person could count. Evacuation ships could not even get off the ground before being torn apart, not like they would make it to the atmosphere, they had nowhere to go anyways this was their only world. The last of the survivors send out a message, a plea for help knowing none would make it in time, a message to warn the galaxy. A shuttle was launched, rocketing upward and through the carnage. The vorax couldnt sense any sort of life force from the shuttle and did not care for it. The pod broke atmosphere and charged its jump drives before disappearing into the void. Leaving behind a once beautiful world, this craft was the last remaining crumb of the Scorian people, billions of lives and the only thing left to acknowledge their very existence was this insignificant distress probe.
